\/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Ch2 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cu style=\"background-color: #d9d2e9;\"\u003EOSCE\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/h2\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #d9d2e9; color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E1) Can diabetes cause Fatty liver, if yes how?\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Yes, Diabetes can cause fatty liver.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003ENon-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is highly prevalent in type 2 diabetes mellitus.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;The pathogenesis of NAFLD is not yet fully understood, but insulin resistance appears to be a critical contributing factor with obesity as the most common cause of the insulin resistant.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EAs body fat stores expand with\u0026nbsp; excess calories and progressive obesity, alterations in lipid metabolism along with inflammation in adipose tissue and ectopic sites of fat deposition lead to insulin resistance.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EInsulin resistance leads to increased its accumulation in body. This excess insulin increases lipolysis and increases the production of free fatty acids.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EThe surplus amount of fatty acids cause an excess production of triglycerides in the liver.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EThis accumulation of excess liver fat is further exacerbated by impaired hepatic fatty acid oxidation secondary to insulin resistance.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: large;\"\u003EThe elevated glucose levels in context of diabetes, further provide substrate for triglyceride synthesis.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: large;\"\u003EAdditionally, impaired VLDL secretion, which commonly occurs with insulin resistance, further contributes to hepatic fat accumulation\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EAll the above factors cumulatively cause fatty liver in a diabetic.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #d9d2e9; color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E2) Is the pre renal AKI due to DKA or vice versa?\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EI think the pre renal AKI is due to DKA and not vice versa.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EIn DKA osmotic diuresis occurs and it may even be accompanied by emesis, which causes dehydration\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Ca #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cb style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: large;\"\u003E\u003Cu style=\"background-color: #d9d2e9;\"\u003E3) How much of a role does a renal cyst play in causing AKI?\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EEnclosed liquid or semisolid fluid is called a cyst and are commonly identified on imaging.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EThe currently accepted hypothesis is that renal ischaemia or injury prompts an aberrant hypertrophic response leading to cyst growth and leads to further nephron loss due to compensatory hyperfiltration.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003ESo thus, a renal cyst can occur as a consequence of ischaemia which is actually a cause of AKI\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #d9d2e9; color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E4) What is phantom lung tumor?\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EPhantom or vanishing tumor stands for a localized transudative interlobar pleural fluid collection in congestive heart failure.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EIt appears as a tumor on chest Xray and disappears after appropriate management of heart failure.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #d9d2e9; color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #d9d2e9; color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E5) How to differentiate between pneumonia and phantom lung tumor?\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EWhile both pneumonia and phantom tumor may present with SOB, cough and have similar chest Xray findings, cough due to pneumonia is mostly associated with expectoration and fever may also be present, which not the case for phantom tumor.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EHeart failure symptoms like orthopnea, dysnea are seen in phantom tumor where as infection symptoms are seen in pneumonia like fever, cold and cough with expectoration.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EMore over Phantom tumor resolves once appropriate treatment for heart failure is started.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Ch2 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #d9d2e9; color: #20124d; font-size: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EI learnt about the seriousness of uncontrolled diabetes.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/li\u003E\u003C\/ul\u003E\u003Cul style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cli\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-size: medium;\"\u003EHow important is it KCL 20mEq in 500 NS over 5hrs\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E5) GRBS moniter hourly\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #d9d2e9; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cb style=\"background-color: #20124d;\"\u003E3\/12\/2023\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E1) Inj. PIPTAZ 2.25gm IV\/TID\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E2) Inj. LINEZOLID 600mg IV\/BD\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E3) Tab. AZITHROMYCIN 500mg OD\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E4) Tab. FLUCONAZOLE 150 mg OD\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E5) Inj. PAN 40mg IV\/OD\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E6) Inj. PCM 1g IV\/SOS ( if temp. \u0026gt;= 101°F)\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E7) Inj. LASIX 20mg IV\/BD ( if SPB \u0026gt;= 110)\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E8) Inj. ATORUAS 40mg OD\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #20124d; font-family: helvetica; font-size: medium;\"\u003E10) Tab.
